messages:
Nina: Quick sync — iterate landing copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Goal: reduce jargon, make intent explicit (self-serve vs sales), and add gateway CTAs for lead routing.

Owen: Draft hero lines per product — shortlist: 
Hosted: 'Try the Hosted API — fast responses, no infra', 'Instant API access for text & embeddings'
Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity for predictable production throughput', 'Dedicated GPU pools with SLA backing'
Private: 'Private deployments: VPC & on-prem inference', 'Bring inference inside your network with KMS support'

Priya: Prefer these CTAs and microcopy: 
Hosted CTA: 'Try API — free credit'
Dedicated CTA: 'Request reserved capacity'
Private CTA: 'Talk to sales — private deployment'
Add tiny chips under each hero (one-liners): Hosted: 'median latency ~75ms', Dedicated: 'SLA-ready, reserved GPUs', Private: 'VPC / on-prem with KMS'.

Sam: Routing rules to implement: 
- Hosted CTA -> direct signup & API keys (self-serve).
- Dedicated & Private -> gated form that creates a lead in CRM and tags route: 'dedicated-inquiry' or 'private-inquiry'.
- Forms should capture: company name, company size bracket, estimated monthly tokens, preferred cloud or on-prem.

Harper: Add a short test for hero messaging. Suggest A/B comparing benefit vs proof: 
config string for infra team: 
```json
{"experiment":"hero_mode_type","variants":[{"id":"benefit","headline":"Ship LLM features quickly, no infra to manage"},{"id":"proof","headline":"Trusted by engineers for 99.9% SLA readiness"}],"primary_metric":"signup_conversion"}
```

Nina: Nice. For Dedicated/Private forms, include a 'Request quote' button (not generic contact). Add checkboxes for compliance: SOC2, ISO, HIPAA and a 'PCI needed' yes/no. If any compliance box checked -> route to Compliance SE queue.

Owen: Small copy note: under the comparison table, add a short row for 'Deployment time' (minutes for Hosted, days for Dedicated, weeks for Private estimate). Also show 'Support model' (Docs + Community for Hosted, SE + SLA for Dedicated, Enterprise + Onsite option for Private).

Priya: Webinar tie-in: 'Inference modes explained: when to choose Hosted, Dedicated, Private' — record as gated replay behind a form that tags 'webinar_replay' and nudges MQL. Target date: mid-May. Include customer panel + brief benchmark demo.

forms-bot: Reminder — append UTM params, include hidden 'first_touch' and 'utm_source' fields, and pass channel tag (org, paid, partner). Also ensure forms send lead source to CRM.

Sam: Add a 1-line testimonial on Dedicated: "Switched to dedicated pools and regained predictable latency — our error budget recovered."  credit: customer initials OK.

Nina: Action items summary: Owen finalize hero lines + chips, Priya craft CTA microcopy and comparison table copy, Sam implement routing rules and form fields with compliance triggers, Harper set up AB snippet with infra. We'll reconvene after mockups.

Owen: On it :rocket:

Priya: I'll post draft copy in #marketing-design tomorrow.

Nina: Thanks team — aim to push first pass next week.
